Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the data from the ATP Tour website in Step 11. The webpage clearly displayed "Career High Rank (1988.09.12): 51", but the Planner hallucinated that the career high rank was No. 4. The value "No. 4" likely came from the same page's mention of his doubles ranking ("highest doubles ranking of World No. 4"), which the Planner confused with the singles ranking. This error led to the false conclusion that Lozano (No. 4) had a better ranking than Vinci (No. 7), resulting in the wrong final answer.
